description: Commercial Parking is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. View full metadata Description This layer contains point features of all Commercial parking lots in the City of Cambridge. These include private and municipal lots and garages and their addresses. About Edit Dates This data is automatically updated on a set schedule. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking, gis, map. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Cambridge GIS. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
